full_judgment: 2. The appellant as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 61 of 1964 in the Court of Munsif, Fatickchari claiming title to the suit land on the basis of pattan from the landlords. R.S. Plot No.3226 appertaining to R.S. Khatian No. 1234 of mouza Uttar Rangamatia, P.S. Fatickchari is the subject matter of the suit. Ram Kamal Saha and others admittedly were the landlords. Plaintiff alleged that he was in possession and that defendants had been threatening to dispossess him. The defendants (the respondents here) contested the suit alleging inter alia that the disputed land was taken settlement of by their predecessor Abdul Ali by a patta dated 5th Jaistha, 1207 M.E. They claimed to be in possession since the time of their predecessor. The learned Munsif decreed the suit. On appeal the learned Sub-ordinate Judge, 3rd Court, Chittagong, who heard the appeal, reversed the decision of the learned Munsif and dismissed the suit. Being aggrieved, the plaintiff has moved this Court and obtained the present rule.
